tagline: We create innovative solutions for aerospace, defense and industrial markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Aerospace segment revenue is the company's primary driver, representing 64.8% of total sales with 14% growth in 2025

kpis.name: Aerospace Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue from the aerospace segment, primarily derived from the sale of systems and components for the aerospace industry

kpis.name: Industrial Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue from the industrial segment, primarily derived from the sale of systems and components for the industrial sector

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin, calculated by subtracting cost of goods sold from revenue

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Consolidated operating margin, calculated as operating income divided by net revenue

kpis.name: Research and Development
kpis.description: Research and development expenses, primarily allocated to product and process improvements

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: Total amount of long-term debt, including private placements

kpis.name: Aerospace Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth rate of aerospace segment revenue
kpis.description: Growth of aerospace segment revenue, primarily driven by sales of systems and components for the aerospace industry

kpis.name: Industrial Revenue Decline
kpis.explanation: Decline rate of industrial segment revenue
kpis.description: Decline in industrial segment revenue, primarily due to lower volumes from reduced Chinese demand and an unfavorable product mix

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

risks.title: Dependence on key customers
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the context of sales concentrated among a few major customers. Significant exposure to major airlines and defense customers represents a material risk.

risks.title: Intense technological competition
risks.score_rationale: Highly positioned in the 10-K with mention of major competitors (Honeywell, RTX, etc.) and risk of customers becoming competitors. Language emphasizes innovation as a critical differentiator.

risks.title: Mandatory regulatory certifications
risks.score_rationale: Presented as a barrier to entry but also a major operational risk in aerospace and industrial sectors. Strength of language underscores safety and regulatory compliance requirements.

risks.title: Cyberattacks or IT intrusions
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in forward-looking statements as potentially impacting financial condition, results, and reputation. Strong language and existential risk for an IT/industrial company.

risks.title: Risks related to international operations
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of risks related to tariffs, global supply chain, and foreign markets. Explicit concern regarding evolving U.S.-China trade policy and its impact on the industrial segment.

risks.title: Dependence on raw material suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking statements as a supply risk. Moderate language, but context of inflation and tight supply chains reinforces its relevance.

risks.title: Acquisition integration
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements as a risk that could affect results. Precautionary but serious tone, typical of major strategic risks.

ai_positioning.summary: WWD does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing.
